title: Vashantor: A Large-scale Multilingual Benchmark Dataset for Automated Translation of Bangla Regional Dialects to Bangla Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance disparity and representation gap of machine translation models on regional Bangla dialects compared to standard formal Bangla using quantitative metrics (BLEU, WER, CER, METEOR) and qualitative error analysis.

Qualitative error analysis of machine-translated texts to identify misinterpretations of culturally grounded expressions, socially contextual words, and emotional nuances specific to regional dialects.

Qualitative error analysis of translation outputs to identify instances of incorrect gender representation and mismatches (e.g., mistranslating the dialectal word for 'girl' into standard Bangla for 'boy').
